description: This file defines the DataTypes class in the org.apache.spark.sql.types package, providing factory methods and constants for various Spark SQL data types and interval types.

classes.name: DataTypes
classes.description: A utility class providing factory methods and constants for Spark SQL data types and interval types.

methods.name: createGeographyType
methods.description: Creates a GeographyType with specified SRID or CRS.

methods.name: createGeometryType
methods.description: Creates a GeometryType with specified SRID or CRS.

methods.name: createArrayType
methods.description: Creates an ArrayType with specified element type and nullability.

methods.name: createDecimalType
methods.description: Creates a DecimalType with specified precision and scale, or default.

methods.name: createDayTimeIntervalType
methods.description: Creates a DayTimeIntervalType with specified start and end fields or defaults.

methods.name: createYearMonthIntervalType
methods.description: Creates a YearMonthIntervalType with specified start and end fields or defaults.

methods.name: createMapType
methods.description: Creates a MapType with specified key and value types and nullability.

methods.name: createStructField
methods.description: Creates a StructField with name, data type, nullability, and metadata.

methods.name: createStructType
methods.description: Creates a StructType from a list or array of StructFields, ensuring unique field names.

methods.name: createCharType
methods.description: Creates a CharType with specified length.

methods.name: createVarcharType
methods.description: Creates a VarcharType with specified length.
